description: Estimate the credit cost of create_actor WITHOUT spending credits. Call this first and show the price before create_actor: each requested format is a separate charged image.

approximate_age.description: Approximate age in years, 18 to 90: actors are adults.

aspect_ratios.description: Formats to create: 9:16 | 1:1 | 16:9, always including 9:16. Omitted means all three. Formats that fail the identity check are not charged and are named in warnings.

description.description: Words describing a fictional adult: appearance, clothing, setting. Naming a real person or a likeness to one is refused before any charge (actor_prompt_refused).

gender.description: female | male. Fixes the actor's gender and the default voice of videos with this actor.

quality.description: Image quality: medium | high. Omitted means medium. The price per image depends on it; quote shows it before any charge.

name: quote_actor
title: Quote a personal actor
